name: novel-forge-editorial
description: A two-seat editorial department for long-form web novels: an editor-in-chief who owns the ledger, the gates and disk-vs-ledger reconciliation, an author who drafts, plus blind-read calibration and zero-LLM instruments. Requires the novelist connector.

displayDescription.en: A two-seat long-form web-novel studio: the editor-in-chief owns the ledger, the gates and disk-vs-ledger reconciliation; the author owns proposals and prose.
displayDescription.zh: 两座位制长篇网文生产线：主编守账本与门控、负责账实对账，主笔署提案并亲自执笔，交付逐章可核。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Scan the charts and give me a topic shortlist before we start the book.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 先扫榜给我一份选题短名单，再决定开什么书。

quickPrompts.en: Scan the charts and give me a topic shortlist before we start the book.
quickPrompts.zh: 先扫榜给我一份选题短名单，再决定开什么书。

quickPrompts.en: Write the next chapter (proposal first, then prose after my call).
quickPrompts.zh: 写下一章（先交提案，我拍板后再写正文）。

quickPrompts.en: Run a ledger-vs-disk consistency check on the current book.
quickPrompts.zh: 体检这本书的账实一致性，把 issue 和 warning 分清单列出来。
